_comment: Single source of truth for team-sprint vocabularies. Prose docs, bash scripts, the PostToolUse guard, and workflow schemas all derive from this file — never restate these lists inline. Drift here is the failure mode that made three enforcement layers disagree.

violation_kinds.impl_test_writer_scope_creep: test-writer modified a non-test file (RED phase is test-only)
violation_kinds.review_no_artifact: reviewer findings never reached the reviews-<story>-round-<N>.md artifact
